name: slopfreedotwork
description: The home for slop free jobs.
author: snegs

scripts.postinstall: GLIBC=$(guix build glibc | grep -v debug | grep -v static); GCC=$(guix build gcc-toolchain | grep -v debug | grep -v static); patchelf --set-interpreter "$GLIBC/lib/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2" --set-rpath "$GLIBC/lib:$GCC/lib" node_modules/@cloudflare/workerd-linux-64/bin/workerd || true
scripts.preview: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
